title: Situational Awareness Dumps Bitcoin Miners After Citadel Sale

title: Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase Launches ChatGPT Plugin for Trading Bitcoin, Stocks, and Derivatives Coinbase launched an official ChatGPT plugin Tuesday that lets users connect an account and trade bitcoin, other crypto, stocks and derivatives in the chat, approving every order. The official plugin is currently available to U.S. users. title: Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls A breach at shipping partner Skladon exposed names, addresses, emails, phone numbers and purchase details for about 27,000 Trezor orders, the company said, and some customers have already reported scam calls. Wallet backups were not involved. This post Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology The Bitcoin Policy Institute said Tuesday it is now the Finney Foundation for Open Technology, a parent organization whose brief spans open-source AI, digital cash and encrypted messaging, with bitcoin remaining a primary focus.
